# antd SDK

> Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, C#, Kotlin, Swift, Ruby, PHP, Dart, Lua, Elixir, Zig, Rust, C++, and Java SDKs for the Autonomi network via the antd daemon. Provides REST and gRPC transports, an MCP server (31 tools), and a local daemon that manages wallet, payments, and network connectivity.

## Quick Start

```python
from antd import AntdClient
client = AntdClient()  # REST on localhost:8082
result = client.data_put_public(b"hello world")
data = client.data_get_public(result.address)
```

## SDKs

- [Go SDK](antd-go/) — `go get github.com/WithAutonomi/ant-sdk/antd-go` — REST + gRPC, context-based (Go 1.21+)
- [JS/TS SDK](antd-js/) — `npm install @withautonomi/antd` — REST, async (Node.js 18+)
- [Python SDK](antd-py/) — `pip install antd` — REST + gRPC, sync + async
- [C# SDK](antd-csharp/Antd.Sdk/) — `dotnet add package Antd.Sdk` — REST + gRPC, async
- [Kotlin SDK](antd-kotlin/) — REST + gRPC, coroutine-based async (JDK 17+)
- [Swift SDK](antd-swift/) — REST + gRPC, async/await (Swift 5.9+, macOS only)
- [Ruby SDK](antd-ruby/) — `gem install antd` — REST + gRPC, sync (Ruby 3.0+)
- [PHP SDK](antd-php/) — `composer require autonomi/antd` — REST, sync + async (PHP 8.2+)
- [Dart SDK](antd-dart/) — `dart pub add antd_client` — REST + gRPC, async (Dart 3.0+)
- [Lua SDK](antd-lua/) — `luarocks install antd` — REST, sync (Lua 5.1+)
- [Elixir SDK](antd-elixir/) — `{:antd, "~> 0.1"}` in mix.exs — REST + gRPC, async (Elixir 1.14+)
- [Zig SDK](antd-zig/) — build.zig.zon dependency — REST, sync (Zig 0.14+)
- [Rust SDK](antd-rust/) — `cargo add antd-client` — REST + gRPC, async/tokio
- [C++ SDK](antd-cpp/) — CMake FetchContent — REST + gRPC, sync + async (C++20)
- [Java SDK](antd-java/) — Gradle/Maven — REST + gRPC, sync + async (Java 17+)
- [MCP Server](antd-mcp/) — 31 tools for AI agent integration, pointers and manifests included

## API Reference

- [OpenAPI Spec](antd/openapi.yaml) — OpenAPI 3.1.0 for REST endpoints
- [Full API Reference](llms-full.txt) — complete endpoint, gRPC, and SDK docs
- [Proto definitions](antd/proto/antd/v1/) — gRPC service definitions

## REST Endpoints

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| GET | `/health` | Health check and network status |
| GET | `/v1/data/public/{addr}` | Retrieve public data by address |
| GET | `/v1/data/public/{addr}/stream` | Stream public data by address |
| POST | `/v1/data/public` | Store public data (accepts optional `payment_mode`) |
| GET | `/v1/data/private` | Retrieve private (encrypted) data |
| POST | `/v1/data/private` | Store private (encrypted) data (accepts optional `payment_mode`) |
| POST | `/v1/data/cost` | Estimate data storage cost |
| GET | `/v1/chunks/{addr}` | Get raw chunk by address |
| POST | `/v1/chunks` | Store raw chunk |
| POST | `/v1/files/upload/public` | Upload file to network (accepts optional `payment_mode`) |
| POST | `/v1/files/download/public` | Download file from network |
| POST | `/v1/dirs/upload/public` | Upload directory to network (accepts optional `payment_mode`) |
| POST | `/v1/dirs/download/public` | Download directory from network |
| POST | `/v1/files/cost` | Estimate file upload cost |
| GET | `/v1/wallet/address` | Get wallet public address |
| GET | `/v1/wallet/balance` | Get wallet token and gas balances |
| POST | `/v1/wallet/approve` | Approve wallet to spend tokens on payment contracts |
| POST | `/v1/data/prepare` | Prepare data upload for external signer — returns `payment_type` ("wave_batch" or "merkle") |
| POST | `/v1/upload/prepare` | Prepare file upload for external signer — returns `payment_type` ("wave_batch" or "merkle") |
| POST | `/v1/upload/finalize` | Finalize upload — accepts `tx_hashes` (wave_batch) or `winner_pool_hash` (merkle) |
| GET | `/v1/pointers/keys` | Pointers this daemon holds owner keys for (`--pointer-keys`) |
| POST | `/v1/pointers` | Create a pointer (daemon wallet pays) |
| POST | `/v1/pointers/update` | Point a pointer at a new target (daemon wallet pays) |
| POST | `/v1/pointers/transfer` | Hand a pointer over to another pointer, irreversibly |
| GET | `/v1/pointers/{addr}` | Read a pointer |
| GET | `/v1/pointers/{addr}/resolve` | Follow a pointer chain to its target |
| GET | `/v1/pointers/{addr}/finality` | Whole-close-group finality check (`open`/`settling`/`unconfirmed`/`final`/`forked`) |
| GET | `/v1/pointers/{addr}/controller` | Follow transfers to the controlling pointer |
| POST | `/v1/pointers/prepare` | Sign + quote a pointer write for an external signer |
| POST | `/v1/pointers/finalize` | Store a prepared pointer write after payment |
| POST | `/v1/manifests/build` | Build an ADR-0006 `.ant` manifest (and `ant://manifest/` link) from DataMaps and public addresses |
| POST | `/v1/manifests/decode` | Decode a `.ant` manifest, manifest link, file link or address; optional `resolve` for exact sizes |

## gRPC Services

| Service | RPCs | Proto file |
|---------|------|------------|
| HealthService | Check | health.proto |
| DataService | GetPublic, PutPublic, StreamPublic, GetPrivate, PutPrivate, GetCost | data.proto |
| ChunkService | Get, Put | chunks.proto |
| FileService | UploadPublic, DownloadPublic, GetFileCost | files.proto |
| EventService | Subscribe | events.proto |
| PointerService | ListKeys, Create, Update, Transfer, Get, Resolve, Finality, Controller, Prepare, Finalize | pointers.proto |

## Pointers

A pointer is a small, owner-signed, mutable reference: its address is derived from the owner's key and never changes, and the owner can point it at new data (a chunk, such as a public file's address, or another pointer). Needs the first antd release with pointers (after 0.15.0).

- antd holds the owner keys, loaded at startup from `--pointer-keys <file-or-dir>` (env `ANTD_POINTER_KEYS_DIR`; key files from `ant pointer keygen --output <file>`). Requests name a pointer by its address (`owner`), never by a key.
- Every create, update and transfer pays (about one chunk's price), and every attempt pays again: never retry them automatically. Reads are free.
- Transfer hands a pointer over to another pointer for good; it is irreversible. Check `finality` reaches `"final"` before relying on it.
- Counters are decimal strings in both transports: a final pointer sits at 2^64−1 (18446744073709551615).
- Every SDK has `pointer_keys`, `pointer_create`, `pointer_update`, `pointer_transfer`, `pointer_get`, `pointer_resolve`, `pointer_finality`, `pointer_controller`, `pointer_prepare` and `pointer_finalize`, cased per language (`pointerCreate`, `PointerCreateAsync`, ...). Over gRPC in C++, C#, Dart, Elixir, Go, Java, Kotlin, Python, Ruby, Rust and Swift; JS/TS, Lua, PHP and Zig are REST only. The FFI bindings do not have pointers yet.
- Tutorial: [docs/tutorial-pointers.md](docs/tutorial-pointers.md). Runnable example in every SDK: `ANTD_POINTER_OWNER=<address> ant dev example pointers -l <language>`.

| ManifestService | Build, Decode | manifests.proto |

## Error Codes

| HTTP | gRPC | Exception | Meaning |
|------|------|-----------|---------|
| 400 | INVALID_ARGUMENT | BadRequestError | Invalid request |
| 402 | FAILED_PRECONDITION | PaymentError | Insufficient funds |
| 404 | NOT_FOUND | NotFoundError | Resource not found |
| 409 | ALREADY_EXISTS / ABORTED | AlreadyExistsError / ForkError | Conflict |
| 409 `POINTER_FINAL` | FAILED_PRECONDITION + `x-antd-error-code` | PointerFinalError | Pointer transferred or final; nothing paid |
| 409 `POINTER_FORKED` | FAILED_PRECONDITION + `x-antd-error-code` | PointerForkedError (ForkError in some SDKs) | Owner signed two final states, no majority |
| 409 `CONFLICT` | ABORTED + `x-antd-error-code` | ConflictError | A prepared pointer write awaits payment |
| 503 `CLOSE_GROUP_SHORTFALL` | UNAVAILABLE + `x-antd-error-code` | CloseGroupShortfallError | Too few of the close group answered or stored |
| 413 | RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED | TooLargeError | Payload too large |
| 500 | INTERNAL | InternalError | Server error |
| 502 | UNAVAILABLE | NetworkError | Network unreachable |
| 503 | UNAVAILABLE | ServiceUnavailableError | Wallet not configured |

## Manifests

A manifest describes a set of files as one `ant://manifest/` link, or a `.ant` file when the link would pass 1,500 bytes. Each entry has an optional `path` and `size` and either an embedded DataMap (a private file: the manifest is its key) or a public file's address. Needs the antd release after 0.15.0.

- **Nothing is uploaded or paid for.** Upload the files first (`POST /v1/data`, `POST /v1/data/public`, `POST /v1/files`, `POST /v1/files/public`), then build from the DataMaps and addresses they return. Build and decode read the network only to resolve DataMaps, so they can time out; retrying is safe.
- `POST /v1/manifests/build`: `{"name", "embed_roots" (default true), "torrent_info_hashes", "entries": [{"path", "size", "data_map" | "address"}]}` returns `{"manifest": "<base64 .ant>", "link", "entries"}`. Exactly one of `data_map` or `address` per entry. `link` is omitted when it would pass 1,500 bytes.
- `POST /v1/manifests/decode`: `{"manifest": "<base64>" | "link": "...", "resolve": false}` returns `{"source": "manifest" | "file_link", "name", "torrent_info_hash_v1", "torrent_info_hash_v2", "entries"}`. With `resolve`, each entry's `exact_size` is read from the network; one entry's failure is in its `error`, not a failed call. Embedded entries carry `data_map` (feed it to `POST /v1/data/get` or `POST /v1/files/get`); public entries use `content_address` with `GET /v1/data/public/{addr}` or `POST /v1/files/public/get`.
- Entries come back sorted by `effective_name` (the path, or the content address when there is none). Unset sizes are omitted (REST) or `null`/`None` (SDKs), never `0`.
- An invalid entry is a 400 `BAD_REQUEST` whose message names `entries[i]` (SDKs raise their bad-request error, also for the both-or-neither check they make before sending); there are no new error codes. Limits: 64 MiB and 100,000 entries per manifest.
- Every SDK has `build_manifest`, `decode_manifest` and `decode_manifest_link`, cased per language (`buildManifest`, `BuildManifestAsync`, ...). The `.ant` bytes are always raw bytes in the SDK (base64 is only the REST wire form). Over gRPC in C++, C#, Dart, Elixir, Go, Java, Kotlin, Python, Ruby, Rust and Swift; JS/TS, Lua, PHP and Zig are REST only. The MCP server has `build_manifest` and `decode_manifest` tools.
- Tutorial: [docs/tutorial-manifests.md](docs/tutorial-manifests.md). Runnable example in every SDK: `ant dev example manifests -l <language>`.

## Port Discovery

All SDKs support automatic daemon discovery via a `daemon.port` file written by antd on startup. Every SDK provides an auto-discover constructor:

```python
client, url = RestClient.auto_discover()           # Python
```
```go
client, url := antd.NewClientAutoDiscover()        // Go
```
```typescript
const { client, url } = RestClient.autoDiscover(); // TypeScript
```

Port file locations: `%APPDATA%\ant\daemon.port` (Windows), `~/.local/share/ant/daemon.port` (Linux), `~/Library/Application Support/ant/daemon.port` (macOS). File format: two lines — REST port, gRPC port.

## Default Ports (fallback when no port file)

- REST: `http://localhost:8082`
- gRPC: `localhost:50051`

## Payment Modes

All data and file PUT/upload endpoints accept an optional `payment_mode` field in the request body:

| Mode | Behavior |
|------|----------|
| `"auto"` (default) | Uses merkle batch payments for 64+ chunks, single payments otherwise |
| `"merkle"` | Forces merkle batch payments regardless of chunk count (minimum 2 chunks). Saves gas on larger uploads |
| `"single"` | Forces per-chunk payments. Useful for small data or debugging |

REST example: `POST /v1/data/public` with `{"data": "<base64>", "payment_mode": "merkle"}`

All SDK `*_put_public`, `*_put_private`, and `file_upload_public` methods accept a `payment_mode` parameter (defaults to `"auto"`).
